semantic.justification: Pinned DBCS lead/trail and EUDC decoding with original error, FLUSH and consumed-byte order. Full multibyte SAL codec/factory parity remains unverified; scoped compiled evidence is described below. Ports ImplEUCJPToUnicode including JIS-0208/JIS-0212, SS2, SS3 and source status/consumption ordering. Ports complete original ImplUnicodeToDBCS and ImplUnicodeToEUCJP entrypoints, preserving reverse table ownership, restricted-range/EUDC/private precedence, signed-char narrowing profile, source empty replacement branches, exact byte capacities and shared undefined/surrogate pointer updates. A constrained compiled witness uses unchanged original converter bodies, original table initializers and original encoding factory bindings. All 786432 BMP descriptor/unit pairs are audited: 786163 defined cases match output/status/consumption digests; 269 original out-of-array reads are classified without executing C++ undefined behavior. Eleven DBCS descriptors, two-plane EUC-JP and canonical forward/reverse exception counts are covered. Source flags outside that witness remain supported through existing tested shared owners; this is not a full SAL/LibreOffice service certificate.
